title: Term Reduction While a Waiver Request Awaits the Committee — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery
content:
On a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**, a waiver request awaiting the Committee on Waivers and Compromises shortens the term of a repayment plan request, because a grant would lower the balance.

**Rule.** When a waiver request with a Financial Status Report attached was received on the debt within the last calendar month counted back from today, the pending-report cut of 4 months is taken off. When only a waiver request without a report was received in that month, the pending-plain cut of 2 months is taken off. Otherwise nothing is taken off under this rule.

**The last calendar month.** A request falls in it when less than one whole calendar month has passed from its date of receipt to today: on 20 October, a request received on 21 September counts, and one received on 20 September does not.

| Waiver requests received in the last calendar month | Months taken off |
|---|---|
| At least one with a report attached | 4 |
| Only requests without a report | 2 |
| None | None under this rule |

**Hypothetical cases.** On 20 October, a waiver request with a report received 2 October: 4 months off. A request without a report received 2 October and none with a report: 2 months off. A request with a report received 15 September: outside the month, nothing off under this rule.
